description: Move submissions along the form's pipeline (the board columns in the dashboard). The stage keys depend on the form's kind and are listed by get_form as `stages` — e.g. applied/screening/interview/offer/rejected for a job-application form, new/open/waiting/resolved for support, new/in_progress/done/archived otherwise. This is workflow, not classification: it never changes spam status. Requires a paid plan.
name: set_submission_stage
title: Move submissions to a stage
